from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialCostRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial record extracted from a single company's report for the specified task."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company in the document")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The name of the cost metric reported (e.g., '营业总成本')")
    value: float = Field(description="The numerical value of the cost metric")
    currency_unit: str = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., '元')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cost_records: list[FinancialCostRecord]
